list: You can drop your charcoal and papyrus after completing the notes all three times.
You can now drop your Sketch after successfully making a Gold bowl.
You can now drop the Binding Book.
While helpful during the quest, the super restore potions and cooked chompy birds are not required to complete it. You will need enough space in your inventory to receive them.
You may drop the rotten food immediately, and the knife after unlocking the coffin.

Upon giving you the Strange potion, Zavistic Rarve will take the Necromancy book, Book of H.A.M., tankard, and portrait from you. After drawing the correct portrait, you no longer need the charcoal, and after poisoning the cup of tea, you can drop the sample bottle.
Ultimate ironmen cannot use the soul bearer.
